title: Programmable DC Power Supply 62000L Series
seoDescription: Low output noise programmable DC power supply with high transient response. Part of Chroma's Programmable DC Power Supplies family, 100W ~ 1.5MW (0 ~ 1800V / 2000V, up to 3750A as a system).

props.title: Programmable DC Power Supply 62000L Series
paragraphs: Low output noise programmable DC power supply with high transient response. Part of Chroma's Programmable DC Power Supplies family, 100W ~ 1.5MW (0 ~ 1800V / 2000V, up to 3750A as a system).

props.body:
- High transient response
- Low output noise
- Standard interface: USB / RS232 / RS485 / APG
- Optional interface: GPIB / Ethernet
- Auto sequencing programming
- LabView and LabWindows support
